title: Shared product listings across stores
description: Allow multiple stores to sell the same product while managing their own pricing and inventory.

title: Multiple stores under one account
description: Let one user create and manage multiple stores from a single account.

title: Store staff roles & permissions
description: Create staff accounts and control access to orders, products, reports, payouts, and store settings.

title: Store approval workflow
description: Approve, reject, suspend, or reactivate store applications manually or automatically.

title: Facilitator commission management
description: Assign facilitators to stores and automatically share commissions based on marketplace rules.

title: Facilitator payout management
description: Allow facilitators to receive payouts and manage commission earnings directly from the marketplace.

title: Facilitator wallet access
description: Give facilitators access to wallet balance, transaction history, and withdrawal requests.

title: Franchise store management
description: Create franchise-based marketplaces where stores can sell approved products under franchise rules.

title: Store Order & Item-Based Commission
description: Apply commissions on the complete store order or calculate commissions separately for each product in the order based on your marketplace business model.

title: Tax & Shipping Commission Distribution
description: Control how taxes and shipping charges are distributed between the marketplace and stores during commission calculations, including commission-based tax handling.

title: Marketplace Fee Management
description: Add additional marketplace service fees as fixed amounts, percentage-based charges, or combined fee models. Choose whether the fee is added to customer checkout or deducted from vendor earnings.

title: Facilitator Fee Distribution
description: Assign facilitator fees globally or per store using fixed, percentage, or combined fee structures deducted directly from store earnings.

title: Payment Method Based Gateway Fees
description: Configure separate transaction fees for different payment methods such as direct bank transfer, cash on delivery, or online payment gateways.

title: Payment Gateway Fee Management
description: Decide whether payment gateway fees are paid by the admin, vendor, or shared between both during order transactions.

title: Flexible Vendor Commission Rules
description: Create flexible commission rules based on products, categories, vendors, memberships, or global marketplace settings.

title: Multiple Commission Calculation Options
description: Calculate commissions using fixed amounts, percentages, combined rules, quantity-based charges, or price-based conditions.

title: Flexible Membership Pricing
description: Create free, one-time payment, or recurring subscription plans for different types of stores in your marketplace.

title: Automated Membership Renewals
description: Automatically renew store membership plans based on weekly, monthly, or yearly billing cycles.

title: One-Time & Recurring Membership Payments
description: Charge stores a signup fee, recurring subscription fee, or both depending on the selected membership plan.

title: Free Trial Access for Membership Plans
description: Offer free trial periods so stores can test marketplace features before subscribing to a paid membership plan.

title: Featured Membership Plans
description: Highlight recommended membership plans to encourage stores to choose preferred subscription options.

title: Membership Plan Highlights
description: Display plan benefits, features, and promotional highlights directly on membership and checkout pages.

title: Store Access Control After Plan Expiry
description: Automatically change store access, permissions, or account roles after membership plans expire or enter the grace period.

title: Plan-Based Marketplace Commission Rules
description: Set different commission rates and earning structures for stores based on their active membership plan.
